ex.ar: […]عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ - رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ - قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، أَيُّ مَسْجِدٍ وُضِعَ أَوَّلُ قَالَ " الْمَسْجِدُ الْحَرَامُ ". قُلْتُ ثُمَّ أَيُّ قَالَ " الْمَسْجِدُ الْأَقْصَىٰ ". قُلْتُ كَمْ كَانَ بَيْنَهُمَا قَالَ " أَرْبَعُونَ ". ثُمَّ قَالَ " حَيْثُمَا أَدْرَكَتْكَ الصَّلاَةُ فَصَلِّ، وَالأَرْضُ لَكَ مَسْجِدٌ ".
ex.en: […] On the authority of ʾAbū Ḏarr — God be pleased with him: He said: I said, "O Apostle of God! Which mosque was laid down first?" He said, "The Sacred Mosque (in Mecca)." I said, "Then which?" He said, "The Far Mosque (in Jerusalem)." I said, "How much is [the time] between the two of them?" He said, "Forty (years)." Then he said, "Wherever [the time of] prayer catches up to you, pray then [and there] for the earth is mosque for you."

senses.gloss: the Al-Aqsa Mosque (on the Temple Mount/Haram al-Sharif)

ex.en: […] I visited Al-Aqsa Mosque, the Dome of the Rock, Omar’s prayer hall (Mosque of Omar), the Church of the Holy Sepulchre, the Christ’s place of ascension (Chapel of the Ascension), Bethlehem, the Islamic Museum, Al-Rawdah College, and the Egyptian Club.

ex.en: "Bind not the camels' saddles (i.e., go not on a [pilgrim's] journey) but to three mosques: to the Sacred Mosque (in Mecca) and to the Far Mosque (in Jerusalem) and to this mosque of mine."

ex.en: Peace be upon you and God's mercy and blessings. Now then…
ex.roman: As-salāmu ʕalaykum waraḥmatu l-lāhi wabarakātuhu, ʔammā baʕdu

ex.ar: كَيْفَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَكُنتُمْ أَمْوَاتًا فَأَحْيَاكُمْ ۖ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
[…]فَأَمَاتَهُ اللَّهُ مِائَةَ عَامٍ ثُمَّ بَعَثَهُ[…]

senses.gloss: to mortify (one's desires, e.g. through asceticism)

ex.ar: فَادْفِنُوا صَاحِبَكُمْ؛ فَإِنَّهُ أَكْرَمُ عَلَى اللهِ مِنْ أَنْ يُمِيتَهُ إِمَاتَتَيْنِ ؛ أَيُمِيتُ أَحَدَكُمْ إِمَاتَةً وَيُمِيتُهُ إِمَاتَتَيْنِ، وَهُوَ أَكْرَمُ عَلَى اللهِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ!
ex.roman: fādfinū ṣāḥibakum; faʔinnahu ʔakramu ʕalā llāhi min ʔan yumītahu ʔimātatayni ; ʔayumītu ʔaḥadakum ʔimātatan wayumītuhu ʔimātatayni, wahuwa ʔakramu ʕalā llāhi min ḏalika!

senses.gloss: Emirati (of, from, or pertaining to the United Arab Emirates)
Emirati (a person from the United Arab Emirates)
position or rank of an emir
